description: Known intentional differences between the demo_eval profile resolution and the values the compose anchor injected for the bot.
notes: The demo_eval profile enables strategies.mapped_zone.enabled; compose pins AUTO_TRADE_MAPPED_ZONE_ENABLED=false so the mapped-zone execution route stays off in production.
AUTO_TRADE_MARKET_MAP_GUARD_ENABLED is not set explicitly by the anchor and follows mapped-zone via the market_map_guard_inherits_mapped_zone compatibility rule; it therefore also resolves to false.
